Wedged between two stones he found a green bottle, its cork sealed with candle wax. Inside was a single page, written in careful pencil. 'To whoever keeps the light: my brother sailed past you thirty years ago and never came home. I have written this every year on his birthday. If you read it, please switch the lamp on once for him tonight.' Elias held the page for a long while. The sea was calm and silver. That evening, long before dusk, he climbed the stairs, lit the lamp, and let it burn until sunrise.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市终于安静下来。路灯在空荡的街口投下昏黄的光，一辆洒水车慢慢驶过，水痕在柏油路面上闪着微光。便利店的玻璃门里，店员靠着收银台打盹，冰柜发出低低的嗡鸣。早点铺的蒸笼刚刚架起，白色的热气升进冷空气里。清洁工扫着落叶，扫帚声一下一下，很有节奏。天边还没有一点亮色，可空气里已经有了黎明将至的味道，整座城市在黑暗中屏住呼吸，等待新的一天开始。", "w03": "- Recursion is when a job is solved by doing a smaller copy of the same job.\n- Think of nesting dolls: you open one, find a smaller doll inside, and keep going until you reach the tiniest one.\n- The tiniest doll is the stopping point, so the process ends and you can close them all back up."}
